correctness.rationale: Eulerian inclusion–exclusion and Fermat give E_p=Phi_p mod p; the exact Eulerian differential recurrence inductively yields E_{p+t}=Phi_p E_{t+1} mod p. Factor coprimality follows from E_{t+1}(1)=(t+1)! nonzero mod p; monic Hensel lifting is unique. Wilson and factorial quotient give F(1)/p=-1/(t+1) mod p, so translated F is Eisenstein. The root uniformizer has p-adic unit class 1/(t+1), and principal-unit Hensel adjustment yields a root of Y^{p-1}=p/(t+1). All p-1 classes are distinct by Kummer valuation-plus-residue classes and exhaust cyclic total tame extensions of degree p-1. The included verifier reconstructs polynomial coefficients and one Hensel step independently for p=3,5,7,11,13, 34 pairs. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

originality.rationale: The final statement is the all-classes local-field realization by the family E_{p+t}, not previously known prime-index Eisenstein irreducibility, ordinary Eulerian identities, or abstract tame Kummer classification. Full text of Sharma–Straus 1974 and Iijima et al. 2019, and the whole accessible arXiv text of Cao–Pan 2006, were compared at theorem and proof level. They do not state this field realization or supply the combination of the prime-block Hensel factor and its exact Kummer class. Public-record comparisons returned adjacent arithmetic Hensel/Kummer results in different objects, not a dominating implication. Residual possibility of unlocated coverage remains.
residual_risks: Any unidentified older specialist source may contain the same Eulerian-index-to-tame-Kummer correspondence in a different notation.
Related historical B-spline/Euler–Frobenius theory could have an unstated corollary providing some local factor classes.
General local Kummer classification is standard and cannot itself establish originality; the Eulerian explicit realization is the distinctive claim.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an explicit, uniform, and exhaustive correspondence between a natural consecutive family of Eulerian descent polynomials and the entire intrinsic classification of cyclic totally tamely ramified degree-(p-1) Q_p extensions, including the exact Kummer unit class for each index. This is a motivated structural interpretation of polynomial arithmetic, not just an irreducibility restatement or an arbitrary finite calculation. The result covers every odd prime and all p-1 local isomorphism classes.
